source.licence: Valve data is not committed; this file quotes ability numbers only. Whether derived Valve data may live in the repo is the open owner decision already recorded in the V7 blueprint.

confidenceScale.HIGH: read directly from the game files (what the ability can target, its numbers)
confidenceScale.MEDIUM: follows from game data under a convention inferred from curated anchor heroes in capabilities.json (the repo has no written rubric)
confidenceScale.LOW: judgement: the game files do not decide it; the owner's call

damageType.evidence: attack, Echo Slash, Talon Toss and Kazurai Katana are physical; only the ultimate Raptor Dance is pure

hasInitiation.evidence: Grappling Claw is a single-target gap closer (range 650-950, cd 13-7, slow 70-100% for 0.7-1.0 s); no AoE disable to open a fight
hasInitiation.anchors: Slark, Riki, Weaver, Phantom Assassin: hasInitiation=false despite gap closers

hasCatch.evidence: Grappling Claw slow up to 100% for up to 1.0 s; Talon Toss (sai) silence 2.0-2.75 s, range 650-950, cd 13-7; Shodo Sai stun 0.5-0.8 s

hasWaveclear.evidence: Echo Slash (cd 21-12) and Raptor Dance (cd 40-30) can hit creeps (target type HERO|BASIC) but neither is a repeatable wave tool

structuralDamage.evidence: no ability can target buildings (Echo Slash and Raptor Dance target HERO|BASIC); Kazurai Katana is a bleed on attacks, not a push tool

teamfight.evidence: Raptor Dance is an AoE (radius 450, 4 strikes, 100% lifesteal) but it is a single-target-focused carry ult
teamfight.anchors: Phantom Assassin, Slark, Anti-Mage: low; Spectre: high

scaling.evidence: primary-agility melee carry; katana/sai crit and bleed scale with attack damage; Rolelevels Carry=3 (the top of Valve's 1-3 scale)
scaling.anchors: Phantom Assassin, Anti-Mage, Slark, Weaver: high

damageType.evidence: Tame the Beasts, Impalement, The Wheel and Spotlight are all DAMAGE_TYPE_MAGICAL

hasInitiation.evidence: The Wheel: point-target, range 1400, mesmerize radius 500, trap 4 s, wheel stun 2.5-3.0 s, explosion 300-600; cd 90-70
hasInitiation.anchors: Tidehunter, Treant Protector, Centaur Warrunner: true (AoE ult initiation)

hasCatch.evidence: Impalement: skillshot range 2400, cd 1, slow 100% for 0.5-0.8 s, bleed 3-6% max HP; plus the Wheel stun

hasWaveclear.evidence: Tame the Beasts: channelled AoE cone (range 700, cd 16-10), damage 50-180 up to 125-480 with channel time
hasWaveclear.anchors: Skywrath Mage, Dark Willow, Shadow Shaman: true

structuralDamage.evidence: no ability targets buildings; Impalement bleed is explicitly a creep DPS (bleed_creep_dps)
structuralDamage.anchors: Lion, Skywrath Mage, Shadow Shaman: low

teamfight.evidence: Wheel 2.5-3.0 s AoE stun + 300-600 burst + aura damage 50-100 per 0.5 s; Tame the Beasts fear/damage cone
teamfight.anchors: Shadow Shaman, Grimstroke: high; Lion, Skywrath Mage: medium

scaling.evidence: the game files do not decide scaling; every comparable intelligence support is curated 'low'
scaling.anchors: Lion, Skywrath Mage, Dark Willow, Shadow Shaman, Rubick, Oracle: low

damageType.highImpact: this field feeds the damage_mix critical gap
damageType.evidence: Catchy Lick, Frogstomp and the songs deal magical damage; his attack is physical but he is a support
damageType.anchors: Abaddon, Snapfire, Tidehunter: mixed; Oracle, Rubick: magical

hasInitiation.evidence: no gap closer, no AoE disable: Frogstomp stun is 0.1 s; Catchy Lick pulls the target 235-325 units over 0.3 s toward him

hasCatch.evidence: Valve rates Disabler at level 1 (the lowest); the only hard effect is a 0.3 s pull (cd 13-7, range 700) plus slow 12-30% from Frogstomp. Pudge's hook is curated as a catch, so a pull can count

hasWaveclear.evidence: Frogstomp: point AoE radius 350, 4-7 ticks of 36-72 magical (up to 504 per cast), cd 20-14
hasWaveclear.anchors: Axe, Tidehunter: true; Abaddon, Oracle: false

structuralDamage.evidence: no ability targets buildings (Catchy Lick targets HERO|CREEP|CUSTOM)

teamfight.evidence: song buffs in radius 800 (spell amp 8-16%, armor stacks 2-4 up to 5, heal bursts 30-80), Frogstomp zone, Croak of Genius shares 30-45% of an ally's damage for 5 s

scaling.evidence: armor stacks per rhythm; the game files do not decide scaling

ifApproved.effect: capabilities.json changes, so its sha256 changes and the 'comparableKey' of every exam/replay changes. F1 must be re-measured on the frozen set with the new curation ('F1c') before any F2 comparison; the old F1 reference stays valid as the pre-curation baseline.
ifApproved.p4: once the three heroes have curated capabilities their team_synergy is computed, not imputed, which removes the mechanism that promoted Kez in E1
